schema.description:
Image content.  
- The image size must not exceed 4 MB.  
- Supported image formats: PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, WEBP, TIFF, and PPM.  
- The transmission timeout must not exceed 5 seconds.  
- The image must not contain rotation information.  
> - If you use the software development kit (SDK), you do not need to specify the PicContent field. The SDK encapsulates this field as PicContentObject, which requires no manual handling.

Image category. For details, see [Category Reference](~~179184~~).  
> If a category is specified, the system uses the specified value. If no category is specified, the system performs category prediction, and the predicted category can be obtained from the response.

PID. For details, see [PID](https://mos.m.taobao.com/union/pub/site/help?spm=a219t.11817172.PortalLayout.d52e56935.27ac6a15wlAEHe).  
> This field is available only if you use software development kit (SDK) version V1.1.0 or later.

Seller type.  
- 1: Tmall  
- 0: Taobao

Specifies whether to perform subject identification. Default value: true.  
- If set to true, the system performs subject identification. We recommend using this option.  
- If set to false, subject identification is not performed, and the entire image is used for search.

Subject region of the image, in the format `x1,x2,y1,y2`, where `x1,y1` represents the top-left point and `x2,y2` represents the bottom-right point.  
> If you specify a Region, the system uses the specified region for search regardless of the Crop parameter value.
Starting position of the returned results. Valid values: 0 to 499. Default value: 0.
Number of returned results. Valid values: 1 to 20. Default value: 10.
List of fields to return. Separate multiple fields with commas. By default, the fields PicUrl, ReservePrice, Title, Url, and ZkFinalPrice are always returned.
Channel ID. Used to differentiate channels in the Taobao consortium.
